paper_metadata.title: Novel BCC single-phase solid solution NbTaxTiV refractory multi-principal element alloys with excellent tensile plasticity and cold-rolling formability

evidence.quote: Refractory multi-principal element alloys (RMPEAs) show promise for high-temperature applications due to their superior high temperature strength.
a series of novel BCC single-phase solid solution NbTaxTiV RMPEAs with excellent tensile plasticity and cold-rolling formability were fabricated successfully by vacuum arc melting

process_steps.input_state: pure Ti, V, Nb, Ta metals (purity ~99.95 wt%)

evidence.section: 2.1. Alloy preparation, cold rolling and mechanical tests
evidence.quote: fabricated using pure Ti, V, Nb, and Ta metals (purity ~99.95 wt%) in a non-consumable vacuum arc melting furnace (HVAM-B, China) under a high-purity argon atmosphere. All ingots were subjected to a minimum of six flips and remeltings to guarantee chemical homogeneity.

parameters.deformation: reduction in thickness per pass 0.01 mm; final thickness ~1 mm

evidence.section: 2.1. Alloy preparation, cold rolling and mechanical tests
evidence.quote: The as-cast ingots were rolled into 1 mm-thick sheets using a double-high rolling mill with a rolling speed of 150 mm s-1 (JH-RZH-110, China) at room temperature. Subsequent cold rolling was performed in a multi-pass rolling process with consistent directionality and a per-pass deformation of 0.01 mm, culminating in plates approximately 1 mm in thickness.

other.sample_dimensions: 16 mm gauge length, 4 mm gauge width, 1 mm thickness

evidence.section: 2.1. Alloy preparation, cold rolling and mechanical tests
evidence.quote: Multiple dog-bone-shaped samples were extracted from the cold-rolled sheets along the rolling direction using an electrical discharge machine (DK77, China) for subsequent tensile tests. The tensile samples had dimensions of approximately 16 mm in gauge length, 4 mm in gauge width, and 1 mm in thickness.

evidence.section: 2.1. Alloy preparation, cold rolling and mechanical tests
evidence.quote: The tensile samples were encapsulated within a quartz tube under a vacuum pressure of 0.005 Pa, followed by annealing at 1200 ◦C for 45 min to recrystallization and relieving residual stress. After annealing, the samples were quenched in water to preserve the solid solution phase.

evidence.section: 2.1. Alloy preparation, cold rolling and mechanical tests
